description: Patch the article output settings of a product from a JSON body.

body.description: Request body as a JSON object. Fields (at least one, others are rejected): language, keyword_region, tone_and_style, image_style, featured_image_style, global_article_prompt, global_keyword_prompt, internal_links (0-5), brand_color (#RRGGBB) and the booleans auto_publish, table_of_contents, is_cta_included, is_video_included, mention_similar_products, is_infographics_enabled, is_first_person_enabled, are_in_article_emojis_disabled, use_different_featured_style. Allowed option values are in products_output_settings_get data._meta.

featured_image_style.description: Allowed values are in products_output_settings_get data._meta.

global_article_prompt.description: At most 10000 characters; null clears it.

global_keyword_prompt.description: At most 2000 characters; null clears it.

image_style.description: Allowed values are in products_output_settings_get data._meta.

keyword_region.description: Country code such as us, uk or global-us.

tone_and_style.description: Allowed values are in products_output_settings_get data._meta.

name: products_output_settings_update
title: Products output settings update
